note: A5 (task-35 Part B): `(require ns)` with an unquoted, unqualified symbol is a DYNAMIC argument (a local var), not a libspec — no `imports` edge may be emitted for it (the corpus case is `(doseq [ns public-namespaces] (require ns))`). Two-direction: the quoted static require keeps its import edge, and both the static and dynamic spellings keep the reference/name they legitimately have.
